title: What Track3D data may go to outside model providers and AI clients
question: Which customer data may the assistant send to outside model providers, under which contract terms (for example zero data retention), and may a customer opt out? When a customer connects their own AI client, who is responsible for the data that client receives?
context: Web chat sends messages, recent history and up to 50 rows per tool result to OpenAI (AI-REQ-003). Staff agents send logs, traces and billing data the same way (AI-REQ-022). The unreleased mobile branch sends voice to OpenAI for transcription (AI-REQ-021). Over MCP, the customer's own AI client receives the tool results (AI-REQ-017). The Field OS PRD asks only that AI analysis data be stored securely and comply with data protection rules.
